messages:
Zoe (PM): Quick sync: uploaded a compact compare table variant — main asks: reduce column clutter on narrow screens, make perf badges accessible, and clarify pin scope (user vs org). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/compact-compare. Please review briefly.

Kai D.: Checked. Compact mode looks promising but metric column gets cut. Recommend collapsing metrics into a chevron-expand row on <1100px. Badges rely on color alone; add icon + text (e.g., 'P95 120ms').

Priya R.: Copy: replace 'perf' with 'Latency (P95)' or 'Throughput (QPS)' depending on model tag. For pin wording use 'Set default for compare' and in dropdown show 'Only me' / 'Workspace'.

Mark H.: Backend: we currently store pinned_alias; that breaks during alias rollouts. We should store immutable version_id for pins. Also support scope field: scope=user|org. I'll draft minimal API change.

A11y-Bot: Scan results: contrast issue on red badge at low opacity; recommend darker text or full opacity background. Table headers need aria-sort and visible focus outlines. Action buttons should be reachable by keyboard and announce state with aria-pressed.

Kai D.: UX decision suggestion: keep personal pins first ship, expose workspace pin in same modal behind a small toggle (confirm before applying org-level pin). If a pinned model is filtered out, show a top banner 'Pinned model hidden by filters' with 'Show pinned' button.

Priya R.: Agree. Also add tooltip on pinned icon: 'Pinned vX — default for compare (scope)'. Microcopy for banner: 'This pinned model is excluded by your filters. Show it anyway.'

Mark H.: Proposed API example: { "action": "set_pin", "model_version": "mv-9ff2", "scope": "user", "actor": "user-77" } and emit event pin.updated.<org?>. I'll post schema PR tomorrow.

Zoe (PM): Next steps: Kai update Figma for compact mode + banner by Tue EOD. Priya finalize copy + aria labels by Tue. Mark post API PR and migration notes Wed. I'll schedule 20m review Wed 11am. Thanks!
